title.fa: جامعه‌پذیری از دو سو: فردزدایی یا شخص‌شدن
title.en: Socialization from both sides: de-individualization or becoming a person
title.nl: Socialization from both sides: de-individualization or becoming a person

summary.fa: انتساب وضعیت‌ها و درونی‌کردن نقش‌ها دو فرایند مکمل‌اند که در جامعهٔ صنعتی به نظام تربیتی سپرده شده‌اند. دارندرف می‌گوید همین یک فرایند از دید جامعه‌شناسی «فردزدایی» است و از دید روان‌شناسی ساختن شخصیتی منحصر به فرد — و همین دوگانگی جای مقولهٔ نقش را بر مرز دو رشته معلوم می‌کند.
summary.en: Status allocation and role internalization are two complementary processes which industrial society delegates to the education system. Dahrendorf argues that one and the same process is, for sociology, de-individualization and, for psychology, the making of a unique personality — and that duality locates the role category on the border between the two disciplines.
summary.nl: Status allocation and role internalization are two complementary processes which industrial society delegates to the education system. Dahrendorf argues that one and the same process is, for sociology, de-individualization and, for psychology, the making of a unique personality — and that duality locates the role category on the border between the two disciplines.

text.fa: ملاک اصلی تفکیک وضعیت‌ها: وضعیت محول (بدون تلاش و بدون پرسش به فرد واگذار می‌شود — مرد، بزرگسال، پسرِ خانواده، آلمانی، شهروند) در برابر وضعیت اکتسابی (دبیر، مدیرعامل، خزانه‌دار، راننده).
text.en: The main criterion for sorting positions: ascribed status, handed over without effort and without asking (man, adult, son of a family, German, citizen) versus achieved status (teacher, managing director, treasurer, driver).
text.nl: The main criterion for sorting positions: ascribed status, handed over without effort and without asking (man, adult, son of a family, German, citizen) versus achieved status (teacher, managing director, treasurer, driver).

text.fa: این تفکیک در همه جوامع معتبر است ولی مرزش جابه‌جا می‌شود: شغل پادشاه در سلطنت موروثی اکتسابی نیست، و همین دربارهٔ بسیاری مشاغل جامعهٔ پیش‌صنعتی صادق است. موارد دشوار هم هست — «کاتولیک» برای فرزند والدین کاتولیک در سرزمینی کاتولیک، یا «پدر» برای اشمیت؛ دارندرف می‌گوید با توجه به امکانات واقعی انتخاب باید پاسخ هر دو منفی باشد، و ملاک جامع و مانع نیست.
text.en: The distinction holds in all societies but its boundary moves: a hereditary monarch’s occupation is not achieved, and the same goes for many pre-industrial occupations. There are hard cases too — "Catholic" for the child of Catholic parents in a Catholic country, or "father" for Schmidt; given the real possibilities of choice Dahrendorf answers no in both, and concedes the criterion is not exhaustive.
text.nl: The distinction holds in all societies but its boundary moves: a hereditary monarch’s occupation is not achieved, and the same goes for many pre-industrial occupations. There are hard cases too — "Catholic" for the child of Catholic parents in a Catholic country, or "father" for Schmidt; given the real possibilities of choice Dahrendorf answers no in both, and concedes the criterion is not exhaustive.

text.fa: در جوامع صنعتی نظام تربیتی تعیین‌کننده‌ترین سازوکار انتساب وضعیت‌های اکتسابی است: مدرسه و دانشگاه انتخاب فرد را با نیاز جامعه بر ملاک توانایی هماهنگ می‌کنند و مدرک این دو را به هم می‌بندد و سندی بر استحقاق تصاحب یک وضعیت می‌شود. درون سازمان‌ها همین اصل توانایی بدون مدرک کار می‌کند.
text.en: In industrial societies the education system is the decisive mechanism for allocating achieved positions: school and university align individual choice with society’s need by the criterion of ability, and the diploma ties the two together as a certificate of entitlement to a position. Inside organizations the same ability principle works without diplomas.
text.nl: In industrial societies the education system is the decisive mechanism for allocating achieved positions: school and university align individual choice with society’s need by the criterion of ability, and the diploma ties the two together as a certificate of entitlement to a position. Inside organizations the same ability principle works without diplomas.

text.fa: مراقبت نهادی انتساب را به «فرایند تحدید مدام امکانات» بدل می‌کند: حتی وضعیت محولِ «مرد» مجموعهٔ وضعیت‌های ممکن بعدی را محدود می‌کند، و «میانسال»، «دانشگاهی» و «ساکن شهری متوسط» محدودیت‌های بعدی‌اند تا جایی که تنها شماری اندک انتخاب باقی می‌ماند. جامعه همزمان تکیه‌گاه و مزاحم است.
text.en: Institutional supervision turns allocation into a continuous narrowing of possibilities: even the ascribed status "man" limits the set of further positions, and "middle-aged," "university-educated" and "resident of a mid-sized town" narrow it further until only a few choices remain. Society is support and nuisance at once.
text.nl: Institutional supervision turns allocation into a continuous narrowing of possibilities: even the ascribed status "man" limits the set of further positions, and "middle-aged," "university-educated" and "resident of a mid-sized town" narrow it further until only a few choices remain. Society is support and nuisance at once.

text.fa: وضعیت‌های اجتماعی هدیهٔ جامعه نیستند: حتی وضعیتی که بی‌پرسش به فرد واگذار شده از او توانایی می‌طلبد، چون هر وضعیت به نقشی وابسته است و نقش مجموعهٔ انتظاراتی با ضمانت اجراست.
text.en: Social positions are not society’s gift: even a position handed over unasked demands abilities of its holder, because every position is tied to a role and a role is a sanctioned set of expectations.
text.nl: Social positions are not society’s gift: even a position handed over unasked demands abilities of its holder, because every position is tied to a role and a role is a sanctioned set of expectations.

text.fa: پیش از ایفا باید آموخت. مثل هنرپیشه، انسان اجتماعی هم باید نقش و کیفر و پاداشش را بیاموزد؛ این‌جاست که به فرایند جامعه‌پذیری از راه درونی‌کردن الگوهای رفتاری می‌رسیم. فرد تنها زمانی با جامعه ارتباط می‌یابد که دستورالعمل بیرونی را در خود بپذیرد و به عامل تعیین‌کنندهٔ کردارش بدل کند.
text.en: One must learn before performing. Like an actor, homo sociologicus must learn his role along with its punishments and rewards; this is where socialization through the internalization of behaviour patterns comes in. The individual relates to society only once he has taken the external prescription into himself and made it the determinant of his conduct.
text.nl: One must learn before performing. Like an actor, homo sociologicus must learn his role along with its punishments and rewards; this is where socialization through the internalization of behaviour patterns comes in. The individual relates to society only once he has taken the external prescription into himself and made it the determinant of his conduct.

text.fa: از دید جامعه و جامعه‌شناسی، جامعه‌پذیری همیشه فرایند فردزدایی است: انسانِ بدون نقش برای جامعه‌شناسی موجودی است که وجود ندارد، و «انسان محض» باید جامعه‌پذیر شود تا بتواند موضوع تحلیل باشد. تنها یک رابینسون کروزوئهٔ واقعی می‌تواند امیدوار باشد از این تولد دوبارهٔ از خود بیگانه جلوگیری کند.
text.en: From society’s and sociology’s side, socialization is always de-individualization: man without a role is, for sociology, a being that does not exist, and "pure" man must be socialized before he can be an object of analysis. Only a real Robinson Crusoe could hope to prevent this self-estranged second birth.
text.nl: From society’s and sociology’s side, socialization is always de-individualization: man without a role is, for sociology, a being that does not exist, and "pure" man must be socialized before he can be an object of analysis. Only a real Robinson Crusoe could hope to prevent this self-estranged second birth.

text.fa: از دید فرد و روان‌شناسی همان فرایند معکوس است: او خود را در دامن دیگری رها نمی‌کند بلکه آن‌چه بیرون از اوست در خود جای می‌دهد و به بخشی از شخصیتش بدل می‌کند. در آموختن نقش‌ها همزمان خود را در جهانی رها می‌کنیم که نساخته‌ایم و خود را به‌عنوان شخصیتی منحصربه‌فرد به دست می‌آوریم.
text.en: From the individual’s and psychology’s side the same process runs the other way: he does not abandon himself to another but takes what is outside him into himself and makes it part of his personality. In learning roles we simultaneously surrender ourselves to a world we did not make and acquire ourselves as unique personalities.
text.nl: From the individual’s and psychology’s side the same process runs the other way: he does not abandon himself to another but takes what is outside him into himself and makes it part of his personality. In learning roles we simultaneously surrender ourselves to a world we did not make and acquire ourselves as unique personalities.

text.fa: پس دو مفهوم «جامعه‌پذیری» و «درونی‌کردن» محل انجام این فرایندها را در نقطهٔ تلاقی فرد و جامعه اعلام می‌کنند، و جایگاه مقولهٔ نقش را بر مرز جامعه‌شناسی و روان‌شناسی تعیین می‌کنند.
text.en: The two concepts "socialization" and "internalization" thus announce that these processes happen at the intersection of individual and society, and they fix the role category on the border between sociology and psychology.
text.nl: The two concepts "socialization" and "internalization" thus announce that these processes happen at the intersection of individual and society, and they fix the role category on the border between sociology and psychology.

text.fa: کارگزاران جامعه‌پذیری: والدین، دوستان، معلم، کشیش و مقامات بالاتر به‌عنوان کارگزاران جامعه نقشهٔ زندگی فردِ بی‌نقش را برایش ترسیم می‌کنند. دارندرف تأکید می‌کند تمایل جامعه به خانواده، مدرسه و کلیسا فقط برای شکوفایی استعدادها نیست، بلکه پیش از هر چیز برای آشنا کردن مؤثر فرد با وظایفی است که جامعه از او انتظار دارد.
text.en: The agents: parents, friends, teacher, priest and superiors act as society’s agents in drawing the life-plan of the roleless individual. Dahrendorf stresses that society’s interest in family, school and church is not only about letting talents flourish but first of all about effectively acquainting the individual with the duties society expects of him.
text.nl: The agents: parents, friends, teacher, priest and superiors act as society’s agents in drawing the life-plan of the roleless individual. Dahrendorf stresses that society’s interest in family, school and church is not only about letting talents flourish but first of all about effectively acquainting the individual with the duties society expects of him.

note.fa: وضعیت محول و اکتسابی هر دو وضعیت‌اند
note.en: Ascribed and achieved are both positions
note.nl: Ascribed and achieved are both positions
